## Workload

Kofi Asante recorded 836 reads over 435 hours. This represents an average of 1.9 per hour. The workload figure provides a summary of the grading activity completed during the period and allows the volume of work to be considered alongside the time recorded. The figures are presented as a straightforward account of activity, without further adjustment or interpretation.

## Quality

A total of 92 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 59.8 per cent. This measure provides the quality result for the work assessed and should be considered with the workload information above. Priya Anand completed the review and recorded the quality outcome against the reads checked. Together, the workload and quality figures provide a concise account of the grading activity and the review undertaken.
